# FutureWorkAcademy

FutureWorkAcademy is an online learning platform offering practical video courses and instructor-led live classes for AI productivity, personal productivity, remote work, freelancing, solopreneurship, virtual events, and online business development.

## Primary Pages

- Home: https://futureworkacademy.net/
- Pricing: https://futureworkacademy.net/pricing/
- Unsubscribe: https://futureworkacademy.net/unsubscribe/
- Privacy Policy: https://futureworkacademy.net/privacy-policy/
- Terms and Conditions: https://futureworkacademy.net/terms-conditions/
- Imprint: https://futureworkacademy.net/imprint/

## Learning Topics

- AI for Productivity: AI tools for task management, planning, content creation, and daily workflows.
- Personal Productivity: routines, time management, distraction reduction, and focused work.
- Work From Home: home office setup, motivation, routines, and remote work effectiveness.
- Freelancing: niche selection, portfolio building, clients, and freelance opportunities.
- Solopreneur Success: time management, motivation, networking, and one-person business development.
- Virtual Summit Secrets: speaker selection, promotion, engagement, and monetization.

## Access Model

Course links route members with active access to the private library. Visitors and logged-in users without access are directed to pricing.
